items.text:
This game is EXTREMELY buggy and unoptimized. Just using the ALT key to see nearby objects and systems cuts my FPS down to 20. Opening any menu causes an FPS drop. And based on what some other people are saying, just trying to install an object causes extreme memory leaks.

As for bugs, the tutorial is extremely unclear and constantly hops to different sections, making me wonder if that's how it's supposed to work. I also completely broke the tutorial by just interrupting the install task of a cable to get more air. There's no way to continue installing it, and I cannot continue the tutorial or open the unpowered door, because the cable installation job DOES NOT WANT TO CONTINUE.

I see the "Under construction" symbol there. I see it's a task I can do. But there is no way to force complete the task. I can't click on it, I can't do anything.

Do not buy this game. At least not now. I'm going to be getting a refund.
items.text_zh:
这游戏BUG极多且优化极差。光是按ALT键查看附近物体和星系，我的帧数就掉到20。打开任何菜单都会导致帧数下降。而且根据其他一些人的说法，光是尝试安装一个物体就会造成严重的内存泄漏。

至于BUG，教程极其不清楚，还不断跳到不同章节，让我怀疑它是不是本来就该这样运作。我还因为想多喘口气而中断了一根电缆的安装任务，结果把教程彻底搞坏了。没办法继续安装它，我也无法继续教程或打开那扇没通电的门，因为电缆安装任务根本不想继续。

我看到那里有“施工中”的符号。我知道那是我能做的任务。但没有任何办法强制完成这个任务。我点不了它，什么都做不了。

别买这游戏。至少现在别买。我要去退款了。

observations.description: 安装物体时出现严重内存泄漏
observations.evidence: just trying to install an object causes extreme memory leaks
observations.evidence_zh: 仅仅尝试安装一个物体就会导致极端的内存泄漏

items.text: Game is a really cool premise, and at this point (launch of 0.14.something) there's a lot of content. But after about 10-15 hours on a save with various inventories and NPC interactions and what-not, the game becomes about as stable as Charles Manson's latest girlfriend. I mean, memory leaks like the Titanic rolled up in this joint. Game constantly freezes for 2-5 seconds (and that's roughly every 30 seconds or so that it's freezing) on a save with about a dozen hours. Sure, I get that it's Early Access. And optimization typically comes after development and changes. But the save and stability just falls apart after a dozen hours, making it nearly unplayable. I keep getting loops of errors and crashes. Sometimes it just locks up my whole PC. I'm *really* looking forward to being able to play this title, but right now it's an exercise in frustration. Toss it on your watchlist and wait for more time in the oven, I'd say.
items.text_zh: 游戏的前提真的很酷，而且在这个阶段（0.14.something发布时）已经有很多内容了。但在一个存档里玩了大约10-15小时，经历了各种物品栏、NPC互动之类的东西之后，游戏的稳定性变得差不多像查尔斯·曼森最近一任女友一样稳定。我是说，内存泄漏就像泰坦尼克号卷进了这个地方。在一个大约玩了十几个小时的存档里，游戏不断冻结2-5秒（而且大约每30秒左右就会冻结一次）。当然，我明白它还在抢先体验阶段。而且优化通常是在开发和改动之后才进行的。但存档和稳定性在十几个小时后就彻底崩溃，让它几乎无法游玩。我不断遇到错误和崩溃的循环。有时它甚至会把我的整台电脑锁死。我*真的*很期待能够玩这款游戏，但现在它就是一种折磨人的练习。我会说，把它放进你的关注列表，等它在烤箱里多待一段时间吧。

observations.description: 游戏存在内存泄漏，存档玩十多个小时后稳定性崩溃
observations.evidence: memory leaks like the Titanic rolled up in this joint.
observations.evidence_zh: 内存泄漏得就像泰坦尼克号开进了这地方。
